top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology is a mature, independently replicated discovery with a complete arc from proglucagon processing and insulinotropic action to outcome-trial benefit in diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and renal disease. P001 (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) fits a discovery-level prize: the citation names the physiology and the identification of the active form without ruling on priority. P002 (Knudsen in place of Mojsov) is a defensible second, since acylation was real science, but it anchors the citation in a development and a company product. No award is clearly worse than either given the maturity of the work.
